body.message: Dear Team,We are delighted to announce the Eid Al-Adha holiday.According to the announcement from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE), the Eid Al-Adha holiday will begin on Tuesday, May 26, 2026 and continue until Friday, May 29, 2026 as a paid holiday.On behalf of fäm Properties, we wish you and your loved ones a joyful Eid Mubarak, filled with happiness, peace, and prosperity.Nawara AbdelhamidPeople & Culture Specialist,M: +971521317852Visit: www.famproperties.comGrab a copyThe Art of Real Estate InvestmentEmpowering Smarter DecisionsStay connected Stay ahead of the property market.
